messages:
Harper: quick ask for next Tues launch — we need a modular "slice pack": 4 small benchmark tiles (latency, cost, throughput, reliability) that can be assembled into hero or 1-column email, a 16:9 webinar hero, and a trimmed 3-bullet sales slide. Also need a 3s motion variant of the latency tile for social. Deadline: Fri EOD. Who can own comps + exports?

Ravi: I can take exports. question: should tiles include region micro-sparklines or a single global line?

Harper: prefer region micro-sparklines (NA / EU / APAC) but keep them tiny; main stat = % delta, raw number as footnote. add a data-source line.

Sofia: i'll design. also propose componentized figma with autosize frame so sales can reorder tiles. will include alt-text and WCAG notes.

DesignBot: figma file created -> https://redwood.app/figma/slicepack-3471001234 (components: tile, hero-16x9, motion-latency). Export tokens preconfigured (svg, png@2x, gif).

Marta: localization scope EN/FR/DE/JP. please provide keyed CSV with context + alt-text column. I can translate. Also confirm number formatting per locale.

Harper: yes localize separators and units (ms / $ per 1M tokens). Marta please aim for Thu AM.

Comms: copy tones needed: technical (blog), narrative (webinar), concise (social). i'll drop CSV with three headline variants. Also want two CTA flavors for social: "Register" and "See the numbers".

LegalOps: legal check: no comparative superlatives; use approx sign (~) or ranges; include data-source footnote. send final copy to me 24h before publish.

Ravi: export spec: hero 1920x1080 PNG@2x, tiles SVG + PNG@2x, motion GIF 1080x1080 3s loop (30fps), PPTX template (editable text boxes). naming convention: slice_tile_latency_EN_v1.svg, slice_hero_EN_v1_1920x1080.png, slice_latency_motion_EN_v1.gif. add _cobrand and locale suffixes.

Sofia: I'll add muted palette and grayscale print variant and annotate file with exact export settings. also adding a tiny manifest and readme with one-line copy variants for sales.

OpsBot: automated note: please include a small CSV manifest with file paths, sizes, and checksums for ops ingestion.

Marta: translation plan ack. will return localized files Fri AM.

Harper: great — Sofia, drop figma link + first screenshots in this thread when ready and i'll route to product + sales. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
